port=8080
max_connections=100

## Database Settings
db_host=localhost

log_file=/var/log/myapp.log

## Security Settings
enable_ssl=true
ssl_cert_path=/etc/ssl/certs/myapp.crt

### Performance Tuning
cache_size=1024
thread_pool=20

## Miscellaneous
debug_mode=false
